decisions: Match the paper box supplier to the actual box structure and target sales channel before requesting a quote.
Avoid comparing suppliers only by generic price; prepare size, quantity, material direction and print requirements first.
If the product needs inserts, retail display or shipping protection, include that in the first RFQ message.
